=== BIKI Search ===

It is possible to define the Community wiki as a custom search engine using the {{hl|1= https://community.bistudio.com/wiki?search=%s}} URL - below are tutorials for various browsers:
{{Columns|5|
* {{Link|https://support.mozilla.org/kb/add-or-remove-search-engine-firefox|Firefox}}
* {{Link|https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95426|Chrome}}
* {{Link|https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/change-your-default-search-engine-in-microsoft-edge-cccaf51c-a4df-a43e-8036-d4d2c527a791|Edge}}
* {{Link|https://support.brave.com/hc/articles/360017479752-How-do-I-set-my-default-search-engine|Brave}}
* {{Link|https://help.opera.com/en/latest/search/|Opera}}
}}
